nurture_circle.title: The Circle Remembers
nurture_circle.body: You claimed the veins without closing every door. The lost who walked them returned carrying songs, not silence alone. The ember holds — fragile, listening. Whatever dominion waits beyond this ash, it will remember that you opened the havens first.
nurture_circle.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? Warmth along the lines. A circle that still knows how to open.

harvest_dominion.title: The Dominion Closes
harvest_dominion.body: You cut and claimed. The veins yield. Eyes go quiet the way they did at the first haven. The ash bows under a firm will — and the pulse answers louder for it. This is dominion: not sudden, but the shape you taught from the first demand.
harvest_dominion.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? Bound hands. Lines already marked. An ember that expects obedience.

collapse_ash.title: Ash Claims the Ember
collapse_ash.body: The circle fails. The pulse guttered, or the veins took back everyone who walked them. You wake again — or something like waking — in dark ash with no memory of how you got here. The cycle does not care which weight you chose.
collapse_ash.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? Scattered embers. No circle. The same first choice waiting.

true_echo.title: The True Echo
true_echo.body: You never taught the ash to demand. You sheltered, you listened, you raised a place where voices answer voices. Along the veins the Bound are not Bound — they are a choir that chose to stay. The pulse does not obey you. It answers. That difference is the hidden ending the ash keeps for those who refuse the easy will.
true_echo.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? An open gate that asks nothing. Echoes that remember mercy as architecture.

sparse_hearth.title: The Sparse Hearth
sparse_hearth.body: You claimed the veins and left the ash almost bare of walls. No foundry, no binder, no choir of stone — only the ember and the few who walked with you. The builder would not leave in disgust; there was little to abandon. The circle holds because it stayed small enough to know every face.
sparse_hearth.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? A thin fire. Few marks on the ash. A challenge written in absence.

pyrrhic_crown.title: The Pyrrhic Crown
pyrrhic_crown.body: The veins are yours. The ash answers your will. And the hearth is nearly empty — the lost spent on the claiming, the silence you taught finally complete. You win the world the way a fire wins a room: everything that could burn has burned. The crown fits. There is almost no one left to see it.
pyrrhic_crown.legacy: What will the next wanderer find? Marked lines. A throne of ash. A pulse that remembers the cost of winning.
